text: {"assertions":["On 2026-05-25, an off-by-one day bug was discovered in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx where selected values appeared one day behind their labels.","The DatePicker bug was caused by an error that was silently swallowed by a bare except clause.","The fix for the DatePicker bug involved narrowing the exception handler to allow failures to propagate properly and was submitted as PR #1607 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1.","The DatePicker bug could be reproduced by selecting the first day of a month and then reopening the date picker.","After fixing the DatePicker bug, memory usage stabilized at 874 MB instead of continuing to climb past 8 GB.","The DatePicker bug only manifested after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The DatePicker component is part of the web UI, is written in TypeScript, and has tests in ui/components/DatePicker.test.tsx."]}
